note: A place's `word` is the owner's confirmed word, or null for no word. `accept` lists a second word the owner accepts for a place marked '?'. The point is the one the atlas would pass the card: an Overture locality point, or the point named in `pointNote`. `set` is calibration (the rule is tuned on it) or heldOut (never tuned on, PF6). The first held-out set (17 places) scored 0.71 accuracy and 0.62 recall against the 0.80 floor on 2026-11-11 and was folded into the calibration set (`folded`) at the owner's call; a fresh held-out set is cut after the retune.
